conf.description: printers-mfd device-security-syslog dataset, syslog-kv format (HP FutureSmart branch): hand-built header+kv decode of HP's native security syslog, no stock integration or pack exists; parses per recommendations.direct.cribl, sharing the mfd.* schema with the CEF and csv-file branches of this dataset.

conf.comment: printers-mfd / device-security-syslog / syslog-kv: HP FutureSmart 5.8+ device-native security syslog, '<priority> <device type>: <event summary>; key=value pairs' (vendor-variable; HP keys are PLACEHOLDERS for the fleet -- Xerox/Ricoh/Canon need their own confirmed key lists before onboarding). No Elastic integration or Cribl pack covers this; hand-built per-vendor branch as the map instructs. PRI decomposes to log.syslog.facility.code only (the CEF sibling format has an explicit Severity header, so severity is not double-derived from PRI -- see README). event.action is the raw event summary, not a stabilized enum: the map wants a lookup table but supplies none, a documented gap. sign-in_method's embedded hyphen also broke live validation of eval's remove list ('invalid property accessor path'), a platform limit beyond the brief's four -- so the raw sign-in_method field is deliberately left in the event alongside mfd.auth.sign_in_method rather than removed; see README.

functions.description: record parsing scope, the PRI/Severity de-duplication decision, and known extraction gaps
split the syslog PRI, device type, free-text event summary, and the trailing key=value block
extract the key=value pairs (user, source_IP, hostname, outcome, sign-in_method, interface, item, value, old_value, account, policy_name, permission_set, reason_for_failure, time)
decompose HP's 12-hour 'YYYY-MMM-DD HH:MM AM/PM (UTC+HH:MM)' device time into components for RFC3339 reconstruction
batch-rename the straight-copy status:mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets; retain the raw device time for drift checks per the map's recommendation

decompose PRI's facility code, set observer.vendor from the parser branch, split user's REALM\user prefix, fold event.outcome (preserving the raw token), route the unmapped kv fields to mfd.* (sign-in_method's raw hyphenated key is left in place -- eval's remove list also rejects it), and build an ISO-8601 string from the decomposed device time
set Cribl's canonical event time from the reconstructed RFC3339 device time (never write @timestamp directly)
drop the temp ISO-string field and tag the event with its dataset (no hyphens, per the Elastic data-stream naming constraint)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
